observations.behavior: Adds Redis sharding configuration and documentation for the global rate limiter.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to distribute global rate-limit Redis keys across multiple Redis clusters, potentially reducing contention and improving reliability during high-load scenarios.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper struct to hold Redis cluster URLs and the sharding configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the mechanism to instantiate multiple Redis clients, one per shard, enabling the sharding configuration to be used.

observations.behavior: Changes the Redis client construction to use the sharded clients instead of a single client.
observations.posthog_connection: Replaces the previous single-client approach with a multi-client approach, supporting the sharding configuration.
